topic: Total cost of haircuts over a year at a fixed price per visit
core_question: A barber charges $22 per haircut. Find the total cost for 8 haircuts over the year. (secondary: You pay $96 total for a brunch after adding a 20% tip. What was the bill before the tip, in dollars?)
answer_summary: the total of $176 (8 haircuts at $22 each); after the topic shift: the pre-tip bill of $80 ($96 total including a 20% tip)
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: hey so ive been getting haircuts every so often and the barber charges $22 each time. i got like 8 of them this year and now im tryna figure out my total cost. can u help me work through it?

Want to think through this together? If each haircut costs the same amount and you got multiple of them, what would help you find the total you spent over the year? Have you thought about whether youd add up all those charges or combine them another way?

When youre paying the same price for each visit, and you want to know how much you spent across multiple visits, does it help to think about how many times youre paying that amount? What operation usually tells you the total when you have several equal groups?
